description: The stores' screenshot rules per device type, from Apple's and Google's own pages: the exact sizes (Apple) or the range (Google Play), how many a set holds, the format, the size to make, which sets each store asks for, and a simulator that captures each Apple size as is. Then, for the app in this folder, what its store page has per language and which screenshot sets it still needs. Also the videos the page has, which are optional (App Store app previews, Google Play's promo video): ask the person before making one. Start here before making screenshots; capture them with ploa_screenshot_capture, check them with ploa_screenshot_check, and upload with ploa_screenshot_upload.

all.description: Apple's older devices, Mac, Apple TV, Vision Pro and Watch too.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

store.description: One store; both when left out.
